Subject: Acme Analytics — potential AR/VAT mismatch on INV-2026-1127

Team,

I pulled the month-end AR aging and flagged a variance for Acme Analytics (INV-2026-1127). The customer shows a payment on 2026-03-10 for the full invoice amount, but our ledger still shows the invoice open and part of deferred revenue for Q1. I attached the slice of the AR aging and the invoice stub for reference (20260318-acme-ar-aging.csv).

Quick observations:
- Payment date: 2026-03-10 per bank feed, amount matches invoice.
- Payment applied to AR (cash received) but GL shows posting to "UK VAT Clearing" 2305 instead of clearing AR.
- Customer is EU-based and the remittance indicates a reverse-charge VAT note; possible tax reclassification needed.

Can someone from revenue ops or sales confirm whether the customer requested any credit/retention? Otherwise I think this is a straight posting error that requires journal correction and revenue recognition mapping to be adjusted (ASC606 mapping) so Q1 revenue is not overstated.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben to confirm customer-side notes / remit details.
2) Finance (Laura) to approve JE to move cash/AR to correct GL and reclassify any VAT hold if required.
3) I will prepare the draft JE and updated AR aging once we confirm.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole

Marissa — thanks for flagging. I pulled the customer thread and the remit file from Acme; attaching the remittance they sent (20260319-acme-remittance.pdf).

Short context from my side: Acme confirmed they issued the payment on 2026-03-10 and included the note "reverse charge VAT applies - Acme VAT ID: GB999999999". They did not request a credit or retention — payment was full. I originally routed the payment to our UK VAT clearing account because their remittance text matched the reverse-charge language and I wanted tax ops to see it; that was a manual routing error on my part for this specific invoice.

From sales: no discounts, no credits. Customer expects invoice closed.

Proposed fix: move cash entry from VAT Clearing (2305) to Cash/Bank (1010) and clear AR (1100) for INV-2026-1127. If VAT needs to be documented as reverse charge, we should produce the VAT proof, but that doesn't change recognition — just tax metadata.

Ben

Adding my two cents — Acme is on our subscription plan with quarterly recognition rules. For this contract, revenue should have been recognized over Q1 after activation on 2026-01-15. If the cash was posted to VAT clearing, revenue might have been prematurely held in deferred accounts or not recognized properly.

Please make sure the JE ties to the revenue recognition mapping for contract ACME-2026-SUB-1 (I added the contract id in HubSpot). If we move cash and clear AR without adjusting revenue accounts, we could under/over-recognize.

If Finance wants, I can loop in Product Ops to confirm activation timestamp but I believe the current mapping is correct — this looks like a posting mismatch only.

Thanks — Rohan
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clear summary. Looks like an operational posting error, agreed. Approve moving forward with a correcting journal. Please prepare JE per the draft below and upload to NetSuite for posting with 2026-03-10 as the effective date. Include referencing to INV-2026-1127 and contract ACME-2026-SUB-1.

Draft JE (please include narrative and source documents):
- Date: 2026-03-10
- JE Type: AR Reclassification / VAT clearing correction
- Debit: Bank/Cash 1010 — 1,250.00 (to reverse VAT-clearing cash movement)
- Credit: VAT Clearing 2305 — 1,250.00
- Then: Debit: VAT Clearing 2305 — 1,250.00 (reverse erroneous tax hold)
- Credit: Accounts Receivable 1100 — 1,250.00 (to clear INV-2026-1127)
- Memo: "Correct posting for INV-2026-1127 — customer remit marked reverse-charge VAT; reclassify cash and clear AR. Linked docs: remittance, AR aging slice."

Also: ensure revenue recognition mapping for contract ACME-2026-SUB-1 remains linked to recognized revenue accounts; do not alter recognition entries unless Revenue Ops confirms. Once JE is posted, update the AR aging and close the invoice in HubSpot.

I've attached a short JE draft for documentation (20260320-je-draft.pdf). Approving this on behalf of Finance. If tax wants to record a VAT note, tax team will be notified separately.
